cases.translation: A wise son listens to his father's instruction.
cases.explain: The possessive construction requires the genitive case for 'father's.'

cases.sentence: От плода своих уст человек вкушает ___.
cases.translation: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things.
cases.explain: Благо is the direct object of вкушает (enjoys), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Лентяй желает и ничего не получает, а желания усердного исполняются до ___.
cases.translation: The sluggard desires but has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
cases.explain: The phrase до конца (to the end/completely) uses the genitive case after до (until/to).

cases.sentence: Праведник ненавидит ___, а неправедные приносят срам.
cases.translation: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
cases.explain: Ложь is the direct object of ненавидит (hates), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Богатством можно выкупить жизнь ___, а бедняку не угрожает никто.
cases.translation: The ransom of a man's life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: жизнь человека (a man's life).

cases.sentence: Свет праведных светит весело, а светильник нечестивых ___.
cases.translation: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
cases.explain: Светильник (lamp, singular) as the subject requires the singular verb form гаснет (goes out).

cases.translation: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it.
cases.explain: The direct object гибель (ruin) takes the accusative case after the implied verb.

cases.sentence: Кто общается с мудрыми, сам станет мудр, а спутник глупцов попадет в ___.
cases.translation: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
cases.explain: The phrase попадет в (falls into) requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Мудрый сын принимает наставления своего отца, а глумливый упреков не слушает.
reading.question: How do wise sons and scoffers respond to correction differently?
options: Wise sons accept instruction while scoffers refuse rebuke
Scoffers accept rebuke more readily than wise sons
Neither group pays attention to instruction
reading.correct: Wise sons accept instruction while scoffers refuse rebuke
reading.explain: The verse contrasts: мудрый сын принимает наставления (a wise son accepts instruction) with глумливый упреков не слушает (a scoffer doesn't listen to rebuke).

reading.ru: Праведность хранит тех, чей путь прям, а нечестие губит грешника.
reading.question: What is the effect of righteousness versus wickedness?
options: Righteousness protects the upright while wickedness destroys sinners
Both righteousness and wickedness lead to prosperity
Neither has any effect on people's lives
reading.correct: Righteousness protects the upright while wickedness destroys sinners
reading.explain: The text states: Праведность хранит (righteousness guards/protects) while нечестие губит (wickedness destroys).

reading.ru: Свет праведных светит весело, а светильник нечестивых гаснет.
reading.question: What is the contrast between the light of the righteous and the wicked?
options: The righteous shine brightly while the wicked's light is extinguished
The wicked shine brighter than the righteous
Light has no connection to righteousness or wickedness
reading.correct: The righteous shine brightly while the wicked's light is extinguished
reading.explain: Свет праведных светит весело (The light of the righteous shines brightly) versus светильник нечестивых гаснет (the lamp of the wicked goes out).

reading.ru: Богатством можно выкупить жизнь человека, а бедняку и не угрожает никто.
reading.question: What is the relationship between wealth and personal safety?
options: The rich can ransom themselves while the poor are not threatened
Wealth brings more danger than poverty
Both rich and poor face equal threats
reading.correct: The rich can ransom themselves while the poor are not threatened
reading.explain: The verse contrasts: богатством можно выкупить (wealth can ransom) with бедняку не угрожает никто (the poor hear no threats).

reading.ru: Презирающее наставление сам себя губит, а чтущий заповедь будет вознагражден.
reading.question: What happens to those who despise instruction versus those who respect commands?
options: The former destroys himself while the latter will be rewarded
reading.correct: The former destroys himself while the latter will be rewarded
reading.explain: The text contrasts: Презирающее наставление губит (whoever despises instruction destroys himself) with чтущий заповедь будет вознагражден (he who respects a command will be rewarded).

reading.ru: Кто общается с мудрыми, сам станет мудр, а спутник глупцов попадет в беду.
reading.question: How do one's companions influence wisdom and fortune?
options: Association with the wise brings wisdom; companionship with fools brings trouble
Companions have no influence on a person's wisdom or fate
Fools provide better guidance than the wise
reading.correct: Association with the wise brings wisdom; companionship with fools brings trouble
reading.explain: The verse shows: Кто общается с мудрыми, сам станет мудр (One who walks with wise men grows wise) versus спутник глупцов попадет в беду (a companion of fools suffers harm).
